meta_title: Fight a Traffic Ticket in Edmonton | Fabsy
meta_description: Dispute an Edmonton traffic ticket before its printed deadline. Learn how pleas, disclosure, resolution, trial, and agent representation work.
h1: Fight a Traffic Ticket in Edmonton
hook: To fight a traffic ticket in Edmonton, follow the dispute instructions before the deadline printed on the ticket, request the available evidence, and decide whether to seek a resolution or proceed to trial. An agent may assist where representation is permitted.
bullets: Use the dispute deadline printed on your ticket.
Edmonton traffic matters are handled through the Alberta Court of Justice.
Attendance requirements depend on the charge, the court, and what happens in the matter.
Disclosure may include officer notes, device records, or video relevant to the allegation.
Edmonton's photo radar program is now confined to school, playground, and construction zones.
what:
What a conviction means

Paying an Edmonton ticket is a guilty plea. The conviction lands on your abstract with any demerits. Disputing it keeps the available resolution and trial options open while the evidence is reviewed.

Common Edmonton tickets we handle include speeding, distracted driving, red-light camera tickets, careless driving, and photo radar from school and playground zones.
how:
How it works

  • Before your deadline, follow the response instructions on the ticket or ask an agent to assist where permitted.
  • Request disclosure, which may include officer notes, device records, or camera evidence.
  • Review the available path. A matter may resolve or may proceed to trial, depending on the allegation, evidence, and court process.
  • Confirm attendance requirements. They depend on the charge, the court, and what happens in the matter.
next:

faqs.q: How do I fight a traffic ticket in Edmonton?
faqs.a: Follow the dispute instructions before the response deadline printed on the ticket, request the available disclosure, and review whether the matter may resolve or proceed to trial. An agent may assist where representation is permitted.

faqs.q: Do I have to appear in court in Edmonton?
faqs.a: Attendance requirements depend on the charge, the court, and what happens in the matter. An agent can tell you if personal attendance is required.

faqs.q: What does an Edmonton traffic conviction cost?
faqs.a: Beyond the fine, a conviction can add demerits to your abstract. The effect depends on the offence and your existing driving record.

faqs.q: Are Edmonton photo radar tickets worth fighting?
faqs.a: Photo radar tickets carry no demerits and do not appear on the driving abstract. Since April 1, 2025, Alberta restricts photo radar to school, playground, and construction zones.

faqs.q: Can I dispute an Edmonton ticket after the deadline?
faqs.a: If the printed deadline has passed, contact the court office identified on the ticket promptly and ask what process, if any, remains available.
Pricing is a flat $488 plus 30% of any fine reduction achieved; there is no additional charge if the fine is not reduced.
